home.heroTitle: Quality lighting and electrical mounting accessories

powderCoating.title: Powder Coating
powderCoating.body: We recolor a product's housing via powder coating — the same quality, in the color that fits your interior.

repair.title: Repair
repair.body: Our service department repairs fixtures. Since most of our products are our own brands, warranty and post-warranty service is faster and more thorough.

profileCutting.title: Profile Cutting & Assembly
profileCutting.body: We cut profiles to any length and assemble LED strips with drivers inside the profile, to the client's requirements.

metalworking.title: Metalworking
metalworking.body: Cutting, welding, and bending of metal sheets and pipes of any configuration, plus modeling and modification of new fixture housings.
